autostart_policy: Control Center lifecycle requires explicit immediate approval and the managed runtime command. Optional Telegram and web services are not enabled by setup.

proactivity.trigger_sources: Explicit operator tasks; Telegram intake only if separately enabled
proactivity.idle_behavior: Control Center remains available under its managed service; no task scheduler is enabled by setup.
proactivity.user_interruption_policy: Tasks support Stop; managed service lifecycle follows the staged-release workflow.
